references.text: God's command to count all male Levites from one month old and upward, which forms the basis for the counting in verse 22
The summary of all the Levites who were counted, totaling 22,000, including the 7,500 Gershonites
A corresponding count of the Kohathites (8,600 men), showing the same pattern for the Levitical clans
A corresponding count of the Merarites (6,200 men), showing the same pattern for the Levitical clans
A later count of the Levites that demonstrates continuity in counting male Levites from one month old and upward
Gershon is mentioned as a son of Levi, and his sons Libni and Shimei are the ancestors of the Gershonites counted here
